<style id="tm-hp-page-styles">
:root {
  --tm-navy: #0B2545;
  --tm-muted: #5A6572;
  --tm-sky: #54A3D8;
  --tm-sky-light: #81BBE1;
  --tm-yellow: #FFCC00;
  --tm-page: #F4F7FA;
  --tm-panel: #E8EEF4;
  --tm-border: #DEDEDE;
  --tm-content: 1200px;
}

/* Full-bleed navy online band */
.elementor-element-3f9a5f7.tm-online {
  max-width: 100% !important;
  width: 100% !important;
}
.elementor-element-3f9a5f7.tm-online > .e-con-inner {
  max-width: var(--tm-content);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  width: 100%;
  padding-left: 24px;
  padding-right: 24px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Section inner width */
.tm-section-page > .e-con-inner,
.elementor-element-ec81be7.tm-hero > .e-con-inner,
.elementor-element-ad247b4 > .e-con-inner,
.elementor-element-210a1a3 > .e-con-inner,
.elementor-element-62c4e3e > .e-con-inner,
.elementor-element-a26dd64 > .e-con-inner,
.elementor-element-8170a59 > .e-con-inner {
  max-width: var(--tm-content);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.elementor-element-ec81be7 > .e-con-inner {
  align-items: center;
}

/* Eyebrow labels */
.elementor-element-002effc .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor-element-8365545 .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor-element-8ae524d .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor-element-72b3901 .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor-element-0136d6e .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor-element-8007353 .elementor-heading-title {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
}
.elementor-element-002effc .elementor-heading-title::before,
.elementor-element-8365545 .elementor-heading-title::before,
.elementor-element-8ae524d .elementor-heading-title::before,
.elementor-element-0136d6e .elementor-heading-title::before,
.elementor-element-8007353 .elementor-heading-title::before {
  content: "";
  width: 24px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--tm-sky);
  flex: none;
}
.elementor-element-72b3901 .elementor-heading-title::before {
  content: "";
  width: 24px;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--tm-yellow);
  flex: none;
}

/* Hero checklist */
.elementor-element-aaaf289 .elementor-icon-list-icon {
  width: 22px !important;
  height: 22px !important;
  background: var(--tm-sky-light) !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
}
.elementor-element-aaaf289 .elementor-icon-list-icon svg,
.elementor-element-aaaf289 .elementor-icon-list-icon i {
  width: 11px !important;
  height: 11px !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  fill: #fff !important;
}

/* Online checklist */
.elementor-element-d654183 .elementor-icon-list-icon {
  width: 22px !important;
  height: 22px !important;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
  border-radius: 50% !important;
  display: inline-flex !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;
}
.elementor-element-d654183 .elementor-icon-list-icon svg,
.elementor-element-d654183 .elementor-icon-list-icon i {
  width: 11px !important;
  height: 11px !important;
  color: #fff !important;
  fill: #fff !important;
}

/* Online section — light text on navy */
.elementor-element-3f9a5f7.tm-online .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor-element-3f9a5f7.tm-online .elementor-widget-text-editor,
.elementor-element-3f9a5f7.tm-online .elementor-widget-text-editor p,
.elementor-element-3f9a5f7.tm-online .elementor-icon-list-text {
  color: #fff !important;
}
.elementor-element-3f9a5f7.tm-online .elementor-element-02a2a0e .elementor-heading-title {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75) !important;
}

/* Trust bar — 6 column grid */
.elementor-element-104b5da > .e-con-inner {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 20px 16px;
  max-width: var(--tm-content);
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
}
.elementor-element-104b5da .elementor-widget-icon-box {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: none !important;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .elementor-element-104b5da > .e-con-inner {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .elementor-element-104b5da > .e-con-inner {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
}

/* Featured products — header row */
.elementor-element-210a1a3 > .e-con-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: end;
  column-gap: 24px;
  row-gap: 8px;
}
.elementor-element-8ae524d { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.elementor-element-feda927 { grid-column: 1; margin: 0; }
.elementor-element-c7bcc4a {
  grid-column: 2;
  justify-self: end;
  align-self: end;
  margin: 0;
}
.elementor-element-aa1743f { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.elementor-element-7855466 {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow: hidden;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .elementor-element-210a1a3 > .e-con-inner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .elementor-element-c7bcc4a {
    grid-column: 1;
    justify-self: start;
  }
}

/* Hero topic chips */
.tm-hp-topic-chips {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
}
.tm-hp-topic-chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 36px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.12);
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--tm-navy);
  line-height: 1.3;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -20px rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.35);
}
.tm-hp-topic-chip svg {
  flex: none;
  color: var(--tm-sky);
}
.elementor-element-a93ce7e.tm-hp-hero-float--topics > .e-con-inner {
  padding: 0 !important;
}
.elementor-element-265eb93.tm-hp-hero-float--topic .elementor-widget-icon .elementor-icon {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  background: var(--tm-panel);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
}
.elementor-element-265eb93.tm-hp-hero-float--topic .elementor-widget-container:has(.elementor-icon) {
  flex: none;
}
.elementor-element-265eb93.tm-hp-hero-float--topic .elementor-widget-heading:last-child .elementor-heading-title {
  color: var(--tm-muted) !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
}

/* Trust bar typography */
.elementor-element-104b5da .elementor-icon-box-title {
  font-size: 15px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
  color: var(--tm-navy) !important;
}
.elementor-element-104b5da .elementor-icon-box-description {
  font-size: 13px !important;
  line-height: 1.45 !important;
  color: var(--tm-muted) !important;
}
.elementor-element-104b5da .elementor-icon-box-icon {
  color: var(--tm-navy) !important;
}
.elementor-element-104b5da .elementor-icon-box-icon svg {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
}

/* Category grid */
.elementor-element-3655e61 .elementor-icon-box-icon {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  margin: 0 auto 12px;
  background: var(--tm-panel);
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid !important;
  place-items: center;
}
.elementor-element-3655e61 .elementor-icon-box-title {
  font-size: 17px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  line-height: 1.35 !important;
}
.elementor-element-3655e61 .elementor-icon-box-description {
  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
  color: var(--tm-muted) !important;
}
.elementor-element-3655e61 .elementor-icon-box-wrapper {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.12);
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 24px 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px -20px rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.35);
  height: 100%;
  transition: border-color 0.15s, transform 0.15s;
}
.elementor-element-3655e61 .elementor-icon-box-wrapper:hover {
  border-color: var(--tm-sky-light);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}
.elementor-element-3655e61 .elementor-icon-box-content::after {
  content: "Bekijk alles \2192";
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  margin-top: 12px;
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--tm-navy);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: var(--tm-sky-light);
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}
.elementor-element-0e49ccb .elementor-icon-box-wrapper {
  background: var(--tm-navy) !important;
  border-color: var(--tm-navy) !important;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.elementor-element-0e49ccb .elementor-icon-box-title,
.elementor-element-0e49ccb .elementor-icon-box-description,
.elementor-element-0e49ccb .elementor-icon-box-content::after {
  color: #fff !important;
  text-decoration-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45) !important;
}
.elementor-element-0e49ccb .elementor-icon-box-icon {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12) !important;
  color: #fff !important;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .elementor-element-3655e61 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  }
}

/* Hero layered visual */
.elementor-element-33182af.tm-hp-hero-stack {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}
.elementor-element-bbc55cd.tm-hp-hero-exam {
  box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -24px rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.45);
}
.elementor-element-82af53d.tm-hp-hero-exam-cta .elementor-button {
  background: transparent !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.elementor-element-e0f0f7e .tm-hp-hero-bar {
  height: 6px;
  background: rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.1);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.elementor-element-e0f0f7e .tm-hp-hero-bar span {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--tm-sky);
  border-radius: 999px;
}

@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .elementor-element-1e5339b.tm-hp-hero-float--ring,
  .elementor-element-e0f0f7e.tm-hp-hero-float--bar,
  .elementor-element-265eb93.tm-hp-hero-float--topic,
  .elementor-element-a93ce7e.tm-hp-hero-float--topics {
    position: relative !important;
    inset: auto !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    margin-top: 12px;
  }
}

/* FAQ — two columns */
.elementor-element-8170a59 > .e-con-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 36%) minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 24px 48px;
  align-items: start;
}
.elementor-element-289fc54 { grid-column: 1; }
.elementor-element-ce29fb3 { grid-column: 1; justify-self: start; }
.elementor-element-3e30f63 { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 3; }
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .elementor-element-8170a59 > .e-con-inner {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .elementor-element-3e30f63 {
    grid-column: 1;
    grid-row: auto;
  }
}

/* CTA band */
.elementor-element-e13cf56.tm-hp-cta > .e-con-inner {
  background: var(--tm-panel);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 40px 48px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  max-width: 960px;
  text-align: center;
}
.elementor-element-e13cf56 .elementor-heading-title,
.elementor-element-e13cf56 .elementor-icon-list-text {
  color: var(--tm-navy) !important;
}
.elementor-element-e13cf56 .elementor-widget-text-editor,
.elementor-element-e13cf56 .elementor-widget-text-editor p {
  color: var(--tm-muted) !important;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}
.elementor-element-7297560 {
  justify-content: center !important;
  width: 100%;
}
.elementor-element-e13cf56 .elementor-widget-heading,
.elementor-element-e13cf56 .elementor-widget-text-editor {
  text-align: center !important;
}
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .elementor-element-e13cf56.tm-hp-cta > .e-con-inner { padding: 28px 20px; }
  .tm-hp-topic-chips { flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; scrollbar-width: none; }
  .tm-hp-topic-chips::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .tm-hp-topic-chip { white-space: nowrap; flex: none; }
}

/* Reviews */
.elementor-element-a26dd64 > .e-con-inner {
  align-items: flex-start !important;
}
.tm-hp-rating-summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
}
.tm-hp-rating-big {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 6px;
  line-height: 1;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.tm-hp-rating-big strong {
  font-size: 48px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--tm-navy);
}
.tm-hp-rating-big span {
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--tm-muted);
}
.tm-hp-stars {
  color: var(--tm-yellow);
  font-size: 20px;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  line-height: 1;
}
.tm-hp-rating-count {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--tm-muted);
}
.tm-hp-rating-bars {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 12px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 8px;
  width: 100%;
}
.tm-hp-rating-bars li {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 72px minmax(0, 1fr) 36px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--tm-navy);
}
.tm-hp-bar {
  display: block;
  height: 8px;
  background: rgba(11, 37, 69, 0.1);
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.tm-hp-bar i {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--tm-navy);
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.tm-hp-rating-bars b {
  text-align: right;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Steps */
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps {
  counter-reset: tm-hp-step;
  flex-wrap: nowrap !important;
  align-items: flex-start;
}
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps > .elementor-widget-icon-box {
  counter-increment: tm-hp-step;
  flex: 1 1 0;
  min-width: 0;
  position: relative;
  text-align: left;
}
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps > .elementor-widget-icon-box:not(:last-child)::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 24px;
  left: 64px;
  right: 8px;
  height: 2px;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--tm-sky-light) 0 8px, transparent 8px 14px);
  pointer-events: none;
}
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps .elementor-icon-box-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps .elementor-icon-box-icon i,
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps .elementor-icon-box-icon svg { display: none !important; }
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps .elementor-icon-box-icon::before {
  content: counter(tm-hp-step);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #fff;
  border: 2px solid var(--tm-navy);
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--tm-navy);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps .elementor-icon-box-title {
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--tm-navy);
}
.elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps .elementor-icon-box-description {
  color: var(--tm-muted);
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps { flex-wrap: wrap !important; }
  .elementor-element-e0d0f17.tm-hp-steps > .elementor-widget-icon-box:not(:last-child)::after { display: none; }
}

.elementor-element-0e41b53 .elementor-star-rating {
  font-size: 14px !important;
}
.elementor-element-0e41b53 .elementor-star-rating__title {
  font-size: 13px !important;
  color: var(--tm-muted) !important;
}
</style>
